# Nimble | Product Positioning

| Dimension | Positioning |
| --- | --- |
| Word location | Light volume CRM centred on relationship breeding, contact enrichment and Microsoft 365/Google Workspace. |
| Main purchasing motive | Reduction of manual maintenance, harmonization of processes and data, improvement of first-line adoption rates and reduction of critical cycles through automation or AI. |
| Competing boundary | 25,000 contacts and storage caps; mail, enrichment and Web capture are additional costs; enterprise-level governance and complex subjects are limited. |
| Evaluation Principles | Validation with real business data does not directly equate a manufacturer ' s demonstration, Logo wall, prize or certification to business effects. |
| Scope and boundaries | A ceiling of 25,000 contacts and storage exists; mail, enrichment and Web capture are additional costs; and enterprise-level governance and complexity are limited. |
